description_en: Revokes permissions on databases and database accounts from a user
description_zh: 移除给用户授权的数据库及数据库账户
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost detach-database-accounts-from-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-pe335ipfk01 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachDatabaseAccountsFromUser

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the DescribeInstances operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用DescribeInstances接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user from whom you want to revoke the permissions on databases and database accounts.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the ID of the user
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除授权数据库和数据库账户的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

fields.help_en: An array that consists of database account IDs
